gaps.explanation: Two parts. (1) Missing fund columns: the governmental funds statement (p4) prints General, Street, Keno and PCI columns. detail[] has only the General Fund departments schedule (pp10-11) for revenue; the all-funds budget schedule (p9) prints revenues combined, so Street (Total Receipts 87,692.11 = Property taxes 18,814.25 + Motor vehicle 1,915.89 + Taxes Other 1,087.76 + Intergovernmental 65,848.31 + Other 25.90), Keno (Keno proceeds 993.59) and PCI (Other 3,924.94) receipts are missing: +92,610.64. The Keno column's other financing row Interest income 142.11 (p4) is also added, in section other financing (not revenue). (2) Different basis: detail[69]-[78] are the General Fund departments schedule's NONOPERATING RECEIPTS (p11: TIF receipts 218,344, Donations 50+5,925+350+557 = 6,882, Interest income 240+4+104+2+7 = 357; printed total 225,582), recorded outside_printed_total but in section revenue; the statement (p4) prints the same money under OTHER FINANCING SOURCES (TIF receipts 218,343.89, Donations 6,882.06, General interest income 356.11), not in Total Receipts 289,938.85. Both are printed that way; no fix. Arithmetic: 422,911 + 92,610.64 - 225,583 = 289,938.64 vs statement 289,938.85 (0.21 = whole-dollar schedule vs cents: General schedule 197,328 vs statement 197,328.21). After the added lines the remaining gap is -225,582.79, all of it the different-basis part.
